title: Do Methods to Jailbreak and Defend LLMs Generalize Across Languages?
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. It evaluates the cross-lingual generalization of jailbreak attacks and defenses on Large Language Models, focusing on general harmful behaviors like illegal activities, cybercrime, misinformation, and harassment.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
